subject: Kickoff: Security exhibit - SOC 2 scope, pen-test window, and evidence cadence
messages:
From: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@medifyhealth.com>
To: evelyn_hart@redwood.ai
Cc: Medify Health Procurement <procurement@medifyhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood MSA + security exhibit questions

Evelyn — thanks for sending the draft. A few items our InfoSec team wants to confirm before procurement can get the order form signed:

1) SOC 2: can you confirm the date range and which Trust Services Criteria are covered in the attached report? We need an explicit statement for our audit.
2) Pen test window: our security ops prefers a four-week window in Jan. Can Redwood commit to providing staging access for that duration and a named point of contact?
3) Evidence cadence: what is the proposed turnaround for evidence requests during onboarding vs. ongoing annual requests?

I attached a short list of questions and the procurement intake form. If useful, Sharon (CC) will join a quick call. Can you propose times this week?

Attachments: medify_questions_v1.docx (docx), procurement_intake.pdf (pdf)

Thanks,
Daniel
Daniel Cho
Director, IT Procurement
Medify Health
From: evelyn_hart@redwood.ai <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@medifyhealth.com>
Cc: Sharon Li - InfoSec <sli@medifyhealth.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2027 10:06:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood MSA + security exhibit questions

Thanks, Daniel — appreciate the clear list. Quick answers up front, then proposed next steps below.

1) SOC 2: Redwood's most recent SOC 2 Type II report covers the period 2027-01-01 to 2027-06-30 and includes Security + Availability criteria. I've attached the report we can share under the NDA / secure link.
2) Pen test window: we can support a four-week staging window. Our standard is to offer a 3rd-party-validated pen test access window with one-week prep + three-week active testing. We can name an on-call eng lead for that window — proposing Karthik as the primary.
3) Evidence cadence: onboarding evidence requests (first 90 days) we aim for 3 business-day turnaround for standard artifacts (config docs, logs, diagrams). Ongoing yearly evidence: 5-7 business days for most items; SLA exceptions for large exports.

Proposed next steps:
- Quick 30-min kickoff: today 2pm PT or Wed 10am PT (please confirm).
- We'll upload the redlined MSA back with inline comments for legal review (Laura will lead that).
- I'll share a pen-test calendar invite with the proposed prep/test windows and our on-call rotation.

I attached the SOC2 report and a draft pen-test access checklist.

Attachments: SOC2-report-2027-01.pdf (pdf), redwood_pen_test_checklist.pdf (pdf)

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Trust & Security Operations
Redwood Inference
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@medifyhealth.com>, evelyn_hart@redwood.ai
Cc: Kar thik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2027 12:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood MSA + security exhibit questions

Daniel / team — looping in legal context for a couple of the items so procurement has clarity on what we can commit contractually.

- Audit rights / evidence scope: Redwood's standard security exhibit permits "reasonable" audit activities including review of SOC 2 reports and sample evidence exports. We avoid full live access to production systems; inspection requests are satisfied via sampled artifacts, encrypted logs, and timeboxed privileged sessions when necessary.
- Pen test coordination language: we can accept a clause that allows a third-party pen test with a defined staging environment, scope statement, and an agreed notification/coordination cadence. We'll add explicit safe-ops rules (no destructive payloads, agreed backout plan).
- SLA on evidence turnaround: legal prefers to keep commitments to "commercially reasonable" timeframes (we recommend 5 business days), with a carveout for unusually large exports or requests requiring engineering time.

Action items for Redwood legal: I'll produce a redline to the MSA/security exhibit that: 1) adds a narrow definition of "inspection resources", 2) inserts the pen-test coordination appendix, 3) clarifies evidence turnaround language. Expect that to be in your inbox by EOD.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference

- Laura will upload a redlined MSA + security exhibit with the pen-test appendix and the "commercially reasonable" evidence SLA language by EOD. (Attachment: redlined_MSA_v3.pdf)

- Pen test window: proposed prep week 2028-01-08 to 2028-01-14, active testing 2028-01-15 to 2028-02-04. Karthik will be the technical lead and reachable on the on-call rotation (karthik_iyer@redwood.ai). Calendar invite attached (pen_test_window_calendar.ics).

Next step for Medify procurement: confirm the pen-test dates or propose alternatives, and accept the redline mechanics so legal teams can exchange official edits. If you want a short video call to walk the exhibit, I can book 20 minutes tomorrow.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
